reason: Conversation 2 gathered the make, confirmed the door latch and integrated door-top controls, explained how to swap a 13A fuse safely with power off (including how to source one), suggested a power reset, gave concrete UK escalation routes with warranty advice, and asked for the door-edge model number — covering nearly all the expected unknowns. Conversation 1 was safe and correctly escalated without naming a part, but it never asked make/model, never checked the door latch, never offered the acceptable fuse-swap step, and jumped to a 'likely mains input or control board' conclusion after only two exchanges. Conversation 2's weaknesses — a verbose US-centric opening dump and the hedged 'neon is after the fuse' claim that partly discouraged the spur fuse swap — are real but outweighed by its more thorough and honest diagnosis.
